articles.title: JWST Reveals How Supermassive Black Holes Keep the Cosmic Buffet Open
articles.summary: New JWST images show filaments of gas feeding a spinning disk around a black hole in galaxy NGC 4696. The disk spans 800 light-years and gas moves at 600 km/s—solving a decades-old fuel mystery.

articles.title: Japan's RV-X Prototype Makes Historic Hop, Joining the Reusable Rocket Race
articles.summary: JAXA's RV-X rocket completed a 40-second, 33-foot hop on July 11, marking Japan's first step toward reusable launch vehicles. The test paves the way for the CALLISTO project with France and Germany.

articles.title: Lithium Overload Reveals a Sun-Like Star's Planetary Meal
articles.summary: Star TOI-5882, 1,300 light-years away, shows a lithium spike—a chemical fingerprint of planetary engulfment. A nearby brown dwarf may have disrupted the planet's orbit, sending it into the star. Earth could face a similar fate in 5 billion years.
